create_env_with_choices: create an environment variable getter that validates values against a list of allowed choices
create_env_list_with_choices: create an environment variable getter that validates comma-separated values against allowed choices
run_validate_environ: run validation to detect unknown VLLM_ environment variables and optionally fail hard
build_compile_factors: build a dictionary of environment variable values used as torch.compile cache keys
test_enable_envs_cache: test enabling cached evaluation of environment variables to reduce runtime overhead
